criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Slide 1 stops the thumb and slide 4's two dogs make the stray/roaming call visible. Slide 5 is a primitive monitor with blank grey bars, slide 9's dog shows its SDF clay body with empty concrete below, slide 2's phone reads as a kiosk on a stem, slide 3's dog is about 1/12 of the frame, slide 8 is a featureless slab, and 6 and 7 read as two tile grids back to back.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One dark register and three working continuity devices, but the reliefs 6 to 8 are a second world and slide 5 a third.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every source primary and every numeral traced. Slide 5's hook 'Then a person checks the call' adds a sequence c4 does not state and contradicts the web edition; slide 3's kicker gives the checks to software; the web edition dek 'A person reviews every clip' overstates c4.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Who, what, where are clear. Who decided, why the city wants the count and what a reader can do are missing; the stake on slide 4 is not built on.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Slide 2 repeats the cover, 5 repeats 3, 6 and 7 are two 32-tile grids, 9 echoes 8, and the close lands flat.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register, house rules held, but much is the release paraphrased, no regional specificity, and the caption opener is flat.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New topic and subject; familiar moves: the lastLight staged world again, a caliche relief, countable grids of square units, a night street with a car.

ranked_defects.defect: Hook adds a sequence and a human ruling c4 does not state.
ranked_defects.fix: Change the hook to 'Software and a person both review each clip' and keep c4 verbatim in the dek.
Put the open question on slide 9 from c6, c7 and c21.

ranked_defects.defect: Slides 6 and 7 are two 32-tile grids in a row saying the same sample fact.
ranked_defects.fix: Fold the 2019 mould and 2026 plugs into one frame.

ranked_defects.defect: Kicker 'What the software does' gives all four checks to software.
ranked_defects.fix: Change the kicker to 'What each clip is checked for'.

ranked_defects.defect: Repeats the cover and the phone reads as a kiosk on a stem.
ranked_defects.fix: Reframe the phone tight in a modelled door and glass edge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Primitive monitor, blank grey check bars, flat clip, subject under half the frame.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Push in so the screen fills two thirds of the frame and set the four check labels as DOM type on the lit rows.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: SDF body reads as a clay toy, bottom 35 percent empty concrete.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Turn the dog fully away and drop the camera to ground level for a rim-lit silhouette against the tail lamps.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Phone on a pedestal stem, no legible door, glass edge or clamp.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Model the rear door frame and lowered glass edge filling the lower half with the clamp gripping the glass.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Featureless grey slab, plain cube report plug.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rake the key low, cut three month courses into the block, make the plug a bound sheet stack.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Dog about 1/12 of the frame, convergence point an unmodelled slab.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Tighten the fov to about 20 so the box and dog fill a third of the frame.
